items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Joe Marshall made the first rock and roll record with Ruth Brown and Lavern Baker and these people, and then I think he recommended me to Leroy Kirkland, because Leroy Kirkland told me that he was using Joe Marshall on these dates.

ctx.x: And he started doing the rock and roll dates for record companies around New York, and at first, the first rock and roll record was really made by Joe Marshall.
Yeah, that's what I wanted to ask you -- I had his name down here, I wanted to ask you about Joe Marshall.
